entries.title: Trading hours & Holidays

entries.title: Euronext announces 2018 holiday calendar for its cash and derivatives markets (20 October 2017)
entries.notes: Press release; states the 14:05 CET half-day close for 24 and 31 December 2018.

entries.title: Resources > Calendars & Hours: Calendar of business days (archived euronext.com pages)
entries.notes: The euronext.com holiday page as captured by the Internet Archive; the live page no longer carries years before 2019. Source for the 14:00 → 14:05 CET half-day close change (14:05 from the 2014 page onwards) and for the 31 December 2015 full closure.

entries.title: NYSE Euronext announces its 2013 Holiday Calendar and early Closing

entries.title: NYSE Euronext annonce le Calendrier 2011 de ses marchés européens
entries.notes: Lists only Good Friday, Easter Monday and 26 December as closures; 24 and 31 December 2011 were Saturdays and 23 and 30 December closed at the usual 17:35 CET.
